job.job_description:
Role Summary:

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with Gen AI experience to build and deploy AI-powered enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React, backend API development, LLM integration, RAG, Azure AI services, and AI-driven application development, with a focus on security, scalability, and user experience.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and deploy Gen AI-powered full-stack applications.
Build secure backend APIs, integrations, and microservices.
Develop modern UIs using React.
Integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and AI agents into applications.
Design AI-native user experiences with streaming responses and feedback capture.
Implement cloud-native solutions using Azure AI/OpenAI services.
Ensure application reliability, security, monitoring, and performance.
Collaborate with business, product, and engineering teams.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI applications.

Required Skills

6+ years of Full Stack Development experience.
Strong experience in:
React
REST APIs
Backend Development (Node.js/.NET/Python)
Gen AI & LLM Integration
Prompt Engineering
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
AI Agents & Agentic Workflows
Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Services
Microservices & Cloud Applications
Experience with monitoring, logging, security, and performance optimization.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

Microsoft Copilot Studio
Enterprise Search Solutions
Containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
Azure Cloud Platform

Educational Qualification

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field.
